description: Java class implementing ValueLink encryption, key management, and communication with external services for payment processing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ValueLinkApi
classes.description: Main class providing encryption, key management, and communication functions for ValueLink payment integration.

methods.name: encryptPin
methods.description: Encrypts a PIN using configured keys and returns a hex string for transmission.

methods.name: decryptPin
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted PIN hex string back to plain text.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a request map to the configured ValueLink URL and returns the response map.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of ValueLinkApi, optionally reloading keys.

methods.name: getInitialRequestMap
methods.description: Creates initial request parameters for ValueLink transactions.

methods.name: getGenericValue
methods.description: Fetches cached database record containing encryption keys for the merchant.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Clears cached keys to force reloading.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates a new Diffie-Hellman key pair based on ValueLink parameters.

methods.name: generateKek
methods.description: Generates a Key Encryption Key (KEK) using Diffie-Hellman shared secret.

methods.name: getValueLinkPublicKey
methods.description: Constructs the public key object from stored hex string.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Constructs the private key object from stored bytes.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Creates a new Master Working Key (MWK) as a 3DES key.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Creates a new MWK from a given DES key byte array.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Creates a new MWK from a pre-generated SecretKey.

methods.name: encryptViaKek
methods.description: Encrypts data using KEK.

methods.name: decryptViaKek
methods.description: Decrypts data using KEK.

methods.name: getDateString
methods.description: Returns current date formatted per ValueLink specifications.

methods.name: getWorkingKeyIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the current working key index, caching it.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into ValueLink string format.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a ValueLink amount string into BigDecimal.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns currency code, currently fixed to '840'.

methods.name: getDHParameterSpec
methods.description: Creates Diffie-Hellman parameters from stored prime and generator.

methods.name: cryptoViaKek
methods.description: Performs encryption/decryption with KEK using DESede cipher.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Creates and initializes a DESede cipher with IV.

methods.name: getPinCheckSum
methods.description: Calculates a simple checksum byte for a PIN.

methods.name: getRandomBytes
methods.description: Generates secure random byte array.

methods.name: getMwkKey
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs the MWK as a SecretKey.

methods.name: getKekKey
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs the KEK as a SecretKey.

methods.name: getDesEdeKey
methods.description: Creates a SecretKey object from raw byte array.

methods.name: getMwk
methods.description: Retrieves MWK bytes from stored data.

methods.name: getKek
methods.description: Retrieves KEK bytes from stored data.

methods.name: getPrivateKeyBytes
methods.description: Retrieves private key bytes from stored data.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses HTML response string into a map of response data.

methods.name: parseHistoryResponse
methods.description: Parses HTML table of history data into list of maps.

methods.name: getByteRange
methods.description: Extracts a subarray of bytes from a larger array.

methods.name: copyBytes
methods.description: Copies source byte array into target at specified position.
